comments.author: Sleepnotdeading
comments.body:
Doesn't matter if you're a fan of AI or not, this is STILL a bad take.   People very obviously do care about the use of GenAI in games, and the industry as a whole cares very much about unfair labor practices.

For small/solo studios, a TON of their narrative is the struggle to make a game all on their own.  There is literal virtue and public value to the struggle.

GenAI is currently rocking the gamedev industry, and the tech industry in general.  It is literally replacing people by the thousands.

And personally, I don't htink the bar on slop has moved.  There's just a lot more of it.

replies.author: ElderBuddha
replies.body:
There's a difference between narrative and reality, across all the points you mentioned. 

Folks aren't getting fired because of AI yet. It really isn't that good enough yet. Look at the financial statements. Check interviews with people who were fired, and folks still at those companies. 

Also literally the people who care about AI in games are scared artists and controversy-hunting journalists. Vocal minority.

replies.author: Sleepnotdeading
replies.body:
Saying people “aren’t getting fired because of AI yet” sounds to me that you don’t know a lot about the state of the games industry or the tech industry as a whole.

Maybe you haven’t encountered it yet, or your reality is different from mine.
